title: A CI fix found in one repo reaches the others: one shared browser-test setup
why: Oct 26: degen's PR 263 went red when its browser setup timed out on Ubuntu's slow package mirror, the same cause claude-settings fixed for itself the same day (c64). The fix never reached the child repos.
note: claude-settings part merged (PR 644, one shared Playwright setup, landed on main e305bdb, Oct 27): actions/playwright-setup pins Playwright from a lockfile, caches the browsers and runs no apt step; gates-shoot uses it (setup 9 s). compliance_probes.py playwright flags installs that run apt; on Oct 26 it flagged degen (2), banchi (2), q_max (1), joyous (1). Decision one-browser-setup-no-apt; three review notes in docs/debts/notes.md. Fault (Oct 26): degen's own workflow; the claude-settings gap was that a CI fix could not reach other repos. Each flagged repo drops its apt step and adopts the action in its own lane; degen also skips web tests on native-only changes. Port: yes, banchi, q_max, degen, joyous. Linked: c76 keeps pins to this action current. Ruling, Oct 28 02:31 CDT (shiv, waiting page item 2, a): yes to the one plan; the other-repo part lands through PRs in each repo. His caution: every repo is paused, but not all their work has merged to main, so each lane reads the repo's open branches and PRs first. Child-repo lanes started Oct 28 02:34 CDT. Merged: banchi#990, degen#287. q_max #978 in CI. Left: joyous; joyous PR 47 found WebKit needs system libraries on ubuntu-latest (c167).
